source: Hacker's Delight, 2nd ed. (H. S. Warren), section 2-1 "Manipulating Rightmost Bits"
description: Next higher number with the same number of 1 bits (snoob, Gosper's hack)
notes: Same idea as Bit Twiddling Hacks #NextBitPermutation; function written by us from the idea. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake already replaces the division by the lowest set bit with a shift by cttz: 9 IR instructions. Division by zero at x = 0 is UB in the source. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
